Brazil football team arrives in Kolkata for friendly match

The Brazilian national football team has arrived in Kolkata for a friendly match against India. The team was greeted with a festive welcome upon their arrival. The match is scheduled to take place at Kolkata's Salt Lake Stadium. This event is generating excitement, with one report highlighting the anticipation of "Samba magic" and another posing the question of whether the Brazilian team can reignite Kolkata's passion for football.
